questions.title: Tell me about a time you failed at something and what you changed afterwards.
Describe a skill you were weak at and how you got better at it.
Tell me about feedback that changed how you work.
Describe a time you had to learn a new technology quickly to deliver something.
Tell me about a time you were wrong about a technical approach. How did you find out?
Tell me about a time you learned what users needed before building something.
Describe a time you went beyond the requirements because of how the feature would be used.
Tell me about a bug or outage that affected users and how you handled it.
Tell me about a time you made sure a quieter team member's idea was heard.
Describe working with someone from a very different background. What did you learn from them?
Tell me about a time you changed something you built so that more people could use it.
Tell me about a time you worked with another team to deliver something neither could do alone.
Describe a time two teams wanted different things from you. How did you resolve it?
Tell me about a time you shared your work or knowledge so another team could reuse it.
Tell me about the project you are proudest of and the impact it had.
Describe a time you took ownership of a problem that was blocking others.
Tell me about a time you had to influence a decision without having authority over it.
